widgets.value:
### Setup
1. Create an **internal** integration at [notion.so/profile/integrations](https://www.notion.so/profile/integrations) and copy its secret (starts with `ntn_` or `secret_`).
2. Share the pages/databases you want the agent to see with that integration — either from the integration's **Access** tab, or per-page via the `···` menu → **Connect to integration**. A token alone grants no access.
3. Paste the secret below and save.

After saving, MCP Gateway picks up the new token on its next reload — reinstall/restart the **MCP Gateway** app if you need it active immediately.
